cases.name: mounted off-on-off uses immediate draft, serialized acknowledgements, and poll fencing
late status reply after save acknowledgement reconciles through a fresh profile read
latest failure presents source banner and actual Retry recovers dirty draft
older rejection follows source clean-draft error semantics and actual Discard clears it
profile ownership rejects missing/mismatch and keyed drafts survive replacement/return
pending save completion after unmount has no component-state callback

ordering.visibleEdit: profile draft changes immediately before set_automation acknowledgement
ordering.concurrentEdit: the same source-derived flush serializes the newer generation after an older successful acknowledgement
ordering.olderRejection: a failed attempted write retains its error even if a newer boolean edit returned the draft to the confirmed value; clean Retry is a no-op and Discard clears via forced read
ordering.latestFailure: last confirmed value and newer failed draft remain distinct; Retry resends the dirty draft
ordering.incomingPoll: receive() fences incoming status while dirty/saving and does not issue its adapter read

ownership.nativeBoundary: existing bridge profile is immutable bootstrap ownership; native SetAutomation persists AutoReconnect in the clone global local config, not a recovered per-profile native store

limits: Controlled inert bridge and jsdom-mounted actual production App/Home/shared ToggleRow/ShellConfigSaveErrors plus the production source-derived draft engine. No Last War process, gameplay, protected original runtime, new command/provider, or per-profile native persistence was exercised.
